description.value: Proudly Canada's first Mezcaleria since 2013, La Mezcaleria is a lively Mexican cantina on Commercial Drive serving authentic regional cuisine made with local, organic ingredients and free-range meats. The restaurant is particularly known for its extensive agave spirits program — flights of tequila and mezcal are a specialty alongside expertly crafted cocktails. Weekend brunch, catering, and full buy-outs round out an offering that goes well beyond a typical neighbourhood restaurant.
